notes:
BUILD 73
- You sit in cars now: body in the seat, knees up, both hands on the wheel (or the bike's bars) and going round with it. With the gun out the hands leave the wheel.
- Your head only turns a bit past each shoulder in a car, and the view tips and rolls with the car, a little less than the car does.
- Headlamps fixed: N really switches them now, on every car, the bike and the minicopter.
- Helicopters have the same seven-part engine as cars, in the hatch after the fuel. New ones come with a regular engine fitted; ones you already own get a part-worn low quality one. Parts wear as you fly, and it will not fly with one missing.
- Explosions redone: a short white flash, a fireball that rolls up and burns out, black smoke that hangs, sparks, clods and a skirt of dust along the ground. They light up what is around them.
- Armour plate no longer covers the windscreen on the pick-up and buggy.
